# 303box

> 303box is a free browser-based 16-step acid bassline pattern generator inspired by TB-303 and TD-3 sequencing workflows.

Canonical URL: https://303box.com/

## Core capabilities
- Program 16 sequencing steps.
- Set note pitch, octave down/up, accent, slide, trigger, tie and rest states.
- Choose sawtooth or square waveform.
- Adjust tempo from 50 to 250 BPM with a hardware-style knob and seven-segment display.
- Adjust cutoff, resonance, envelope modulation, decay and accent.
- Preview patterns with the Web Audio API.
- Inspect the browser synth with a live oscilloscope and spectrum analyzer.
- Detect dominant frequency and nearest musical note in real time.
- Connect supported MIDI hardware through the Web MIDI API.
- Send note messages, accent velocity and optional MIDI Start/Stop/24-PPQN clock.
- Choose Browser, Browser + MIDI, or MIDI-only playback.
- Export the complete pattern sheet as a JPG.
- Store the current working session locally in the browser.

## Languages
- English
- Turkish

- Sequencer: https://303box.com/#sequencer
- Live signal and MIDI: https://303box.com/#live
- Sequencer guide: https://303box.com/#guide
- TB-303 history: https://303box.com/#history
- FAQ: https://303box.com/#faq

## Historical coverage
The site includes a sourced TB-303 timeline covering Roland/Tadao Kikumoto, Phuture (DJ Pierre, Spanky, Herb J), Ron Hardy, Marshall Jefferson, A Guy Called Gerald, Hardfloor, Josh Wink, and the Roland TB-03 revival.
